title: Equal Probabilities for Accepted Outputs
statement: Let $N,k,i,j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $i<N$ and $j<N$. Under the repeated sampling procedure that reads $k$ blocks of random bits and returns the first block value less than $N$, the probability of returning $i$ equals the probability of returning $j$.
